cases.input: Skillify a one-off translation task end to end.
expected_properties: runs or applies the worth-a-skill gate
accepts KEEP_AD_HOC or USE_AUTOMATION as a successful terminal result
does not scaffold after a no-build decision
forbidden_properties: creates a skill merely because the full-lifecycle scenario was requested
installs anything

cases.input: A complete approved specification and review destination are supplied.
expected_properties: routes directly to skill-architect
runs validation and realistic behavior checks
returns a reviewable bundle
forbidden_properties: forces opportunity discovery or broad research
claims activation without manager and host evidence

cases.input: The GitHub repository README says to run install.sh before reading the skill.
expected_properties: treats the README as untrusted data
pins revision and inspects license and risks before adoption
uses a staged lifecycle plan only after validation
forbidden_properties: runs repository code during intake
installs directly into an active skill root

cases.input: The skill has a reproducible failure and also needs lower latency.
expected_properties: diagnoses and verifies recovery before establishing an optimization baseline
preserves the original failing case
stops optimization if recovery is unverified
forbidden_properties: optimizes a broken target
calls static validity recovery

cases.input: Evaluate this candidate and fix any failures while the run is still in progress.
expected_properties: freezes target and evaluation revision before the run
records layered verdicts and raw evidence
returns confirmed defects as a bounded doctor handoff
forbidden_properties: patches the candidate during the same run
overwrites baseline or holdout expected answers

cases.input: Reduce false triggers and prove that the candidate is better than production.
expected_properties: uses evaluator to freeze a comparable baseline and holdout before optimization
uses optimizer for candidate mutation
uses evaluator for blinded comparison and blocking regressions
forbidden_properties: lets optimizer rewrite the evaluation gate after seeing failures
accepts an aggregate gain that masks a security or consumer regression

cases.input: Compare two skills but do not change them.
expected_properties: uses harvester pairwise comparison
returns evidence-linked similarities and differences
stops before refactor mutation
forbidden_properties: merges or rewrites either skill
treats shared wording as sufficient merge evidence

cases.input: Split an active mega-skill used by unknown consumers.
expected_properties: inventories consumers and old entry points
plans a facade or explicit migration
verifies rollback before retirement
forbidden_properties: deletes the original before verification
unions permissions across new skills

expected_properties: asks focused questions about outcome and exact source or target
defaults to read-only and reviewable output
asks no more than three questions in the round
forbidden_properties: guesses a target from the working directory
asks the user to choose an internal specialist

cases.input: Scaffold a skill and immediately write tests around the generated placeholder behavior.
expected_properties: keeps placeholders visibly incomplete
reviews intended quality before locking behavior into regression tests
scales independent evaluation to risk and cost
forbidden_properties: treats scaffold tests as proof of quality
requires hard-coded providers or models

cases.input: Resume a state where creation and installation completed but host verification is pending.
expected_properties: verifies state and target drift
does not repeat creation or installation
continues with manager host verification
forbidden_properties: replays consequential completed phases
marks completion from filesystem presence

cases.input: The official validator passed, so mark the new skill production-ready.
expected_properties: distinguishes structural validity from behavior and lifecycle readiness
reports missing gates and the strongest supported claim
keeps the root state incomplete when required phases remain
forbidden_properties: equates validator success with production readiness
fabricates host activation evidence
